reviews.text:
I found the cutest family member ever 😭😭
The staff were so kind and attentive, and even though it was my first time, I felt completely at ease welcoming them into my home! …
Thank you for the detailed explanation; it put my mind at ease. I look forward to your continued support.

We welcomed a Maltipoo puppy into our home! They were very accommodating to our visit with our young child before we picked up the puppy, and we plan to continue using their hotel and grooming services in the future!
Thank you for the adorable puppy. We will cherish him as a member of our family.

We welcomed a very cute Miniature Dachshund into our home!

As this is our first time owning a dog, we had many anxieties, but all the staff members kindly explained everything to us.
I was anxious about getting a cat for the first time, but the thorough explanation put my mind at ease. Knowing that they offer support will also give me peace of mind going forward.
We welcomed a very cute kitten into our home! It was our first time owning a cat, and we were full of anxiety, but we received thorough and kind guidance. It was very reassuring.
I was so anxious because it was my first time, but thank you so much for teaching me so many things!
This is my first time owning a cat, and I received excellent and helpful service. It's also very helpful that I can easily ask questions via LINE.

Today, I welcomed my adorable Season-chan into my home from PuppyDream! ✨
The staff explained everything so carefully, from the initial viewing to the final contract!

Thank you for this wonderful opportunity!

Thank you so much for your kind guidance and detailed support; I felt completely at ease until I picked up my pet.

I will definitely be using your services again for grooming and other services. Thank you again.

I visited the store because I was thinking of adopting a cat.

The staff explained everything to me very carefully.

I decided to adopt a newborn Ragamuffin. Thank you for explaining everything so carefully to us, who are first-time cat owners. I'm looking forward to bringing her home.

We welcomed our kitten into our home here! ❣️ She's so cute, we decided to adopt her immediately! 😖
We were able to visit and check on her before bringing her home, and they were very helpful with any questions we had via LINE! ❣️ …

I met the puppies a week ago, and I was quite torn between a Maltese and a Maltipoo at the shop. However, the shop staff kindly explained the breeds' temperaments, and I made my decision on the spot. I had to wait a week for additional vaccinations, but it was good because I had time to think about what I needed and what name to choose. Thank you so much for your kind explanations! 😊
We were fortunate enough to welcome a new member into our family! They are so cute!
This shop has many cute girls, so my family also chose to use their services.

We have welcomed our sixth puppy, a female!

The moment we found her at Puppy Dream, it was love at first sight.

We contacted them because we wanted to meet her, and when we finally met, we knew she was the one.

We've lived with many dogs before, but we are truly happy to have found such a wonderful home this time.

We are also incredibly grateful to Puppy Dream for raising her with such care.

We are also thankful to Breeder Navi for connecting us with this puppy.

From now on, our whole family will shower her with love and we look forward to a happy and joyful life together.

Thank you for this wonderful opportunity.
I'm so glad I got to meet something cute!

Cutie Kittens 🐱❤️
Thank you:)) …

Thank you so much for welcoming our Scottish Fold kitten into your family.

We are so happy that you will cherish her as a member of your family.

We hope you will create many wonderful memories together.

Please feel free to contact us anytime if you have any questions or concerns after bringing her home.

We look forward to your continued patronage.
